title: "The Iterator Trait and Protocol"

# The Iterator Trait and Protocol
In Rust, iterators are lazy sequences that produce values on demand via the `Iterator` trait:

```rust
fn main() {
    let v = vec![1, 2, 3];
    let mut iter = v.iter();

    assert_eq!(iter.next(), Some(&1));
    assert_eq!(iter.next(), Some(&2));
    assert_eq!(iter.next(), Some(&3));
    assert_eq!(iter.next(), None);
}
```
